{{Quote|We only train our own. Our profession - and our diet - go hand in hand. If she's not Anzati, She's dinner - well, her brains, anyway.|Anis refusing to train Aurra Sing|<ref name="Aurra's Song">{{StoryCite|story=Aurra's Song|book=Aurra's Song}}</ref>}}
'''Anis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] who, prior to [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="ASORS" /> had become a clan leader amongst his [[Species/Legends|species]]. Whilst in this position he was indebted to the criminal [[Wallanooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and agreed to train [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], the [[Near-Human]] slave the Hutt had purchased, as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. The Anzati assassin he assigned to train Sing, [[Torgo Tahn]], later [[Death/Legends|killed]] Anis with the aid of two of his students.<ref name="ASDH" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Anis was old and dying. His time had come. I'm sure he was glad to be eliminated by someone he had trained rather than by some interloper - somone who got off a lucky shot.|Torgo Tahn speaking of why he killed Anis|<ref name="Aurra's Song" />}}
Anis was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anzat/Legends|Anzat]]. He was a clan leader amongst his [[Species/Legends|species]] prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. Whilst a clan leader, he owed a debt to a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal named [[Wallanooga]], who asked him to train a [[Near-Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] he had purchased from [[Senex/Legends|Senex]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The Hutt showed Anis the slave, [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], and explained that she had been sold to the Senex by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known as the [[The Dark Woman|Dark Woman]], whom the Anzati had heard of but assumed a myth. Sing was too obsessed with violence to be a pleasure slave, but the criminal thought she had potential as a killer. Anis initially refused, saying that he and his trainers would only train fellow Anzati, as their ability to feed on other beings' brains was vital to their technique and as a non-Anzat Sing was nothing but a meal to the clan leader. The Hutt then called in the debt he was owed, and Anis accepted, saying he would accept the slave into his classes.

Anis assigned Sing to one of his ablest assassins and one of his own past students, [[Torgo Tahn]]. Tahn not only trained Sing to be a deadly assassin but attempted to establish a relationship with her, although she rejected his advances. After Sing left his training, Tahn and two of his other students decapitated Anis with a chain, believing that the clan leader was old and dying and so would be grateful to be killed by one of his own students and not by a lucky shot from someone less able. The students then fed upon Anis's brain, not wanting to waste it, but were killed almost immediately after by Tahn for insulting Sing. Tahn then left the Anzat clan shortly after and later recounted the clan leader's death to Sing, whom he had captured,<ref name="ASDH" /> in 36 BBY.<ref name="ASORS" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Anis.jpg|thumb|Anis]]
{{Quote|Very well, if she lives through the schooling, she'll be the deadliest dancing girl on Tatooine!|Anis agrees to train Sing|<ref name="Aurra's Song" />}}
Anis had [[Color/Legends|blond]] hair and pale skin. He considered non-Anzati unsuitable for training in Anzati assassin methods and saw them as food. He agreed to honor his debt to Wallanooga, however, and train Aurra Sing despite the fact she wasn't an Anzat, although he saw the matter as somewhat humorous. Torgo Tahn believed that Anis would rather have been killed by one of his own students then someone not as well trained who made a lucky shot.<ref name="ASDH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anis first appeared in a flashback in the black-and-white comic ''[[Aurra's Song]]'', written by [[Dean Motter]] and illustrated by [[Isaac Buckminster Owens]] and published in ''[[Dark Horse Presents Annual 2000]]''. The comic was republished in color in ''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Rise of the Sith]]'', which revealed the character's hair and skin color as well as the date at which the story took place. Anis received entries in the [[Databank (original)|original Databank]] and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which revealed no new information.
